raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`prefetch_staging_reqs` creates a new `zmq.Context()` for every decode endpoint it first talks to and never terminates it, so a prefill keeps one extra libzmq I/O thread per distinct decode endpoint for the life of the process. The sockets are already cached per endpoint; only their context leaks.

## Modifications

Create the prefetch sockets from `zmq.Context.instance()`.

detail.title: [Fix] disaggregation: Use the shared ZMQ context for staging prefetch sockets

files.patch:
@@ -1000,7 +1000,7 @@ def prefetch_staging_reqs(
                 na = NetworkAddress(tinfo.endpoint, tinfo.dst_port)
                 ep = na.to_tcp()
                 if ep not in prefetch_sockets:
-                    sock = zmq.Context().socket(zmq.PUSH)
+                    sock = zmq.Context.instance().socket(zmq.PUSH)
                     if na.is_ipv6:
                         sock.setsockopt(zmq.IPV6, 1)
                     sock.connect(ep)
